examples.text: He opened an embroidered portfolio; and, from its perfumed depths, took out a letter, which he began to read aloud.

examples.text: Private-equity nabobs bristle at being dubbed mere financiers.[…]Much of their pleading is public-relations bluster. That model is still prevalent today.

examples.text: I would like to introduce you to our portfolio of services.
